GridHQ

Your championship manager. Log results, follow drivers and constructors, inspect season statistics, tune development and keep a full racing season in one focused place.
GRIDHQ ON GITHUB ↗
Race control

Enter results and keep the championship moving without manual spreadsheets.

Season intelligence

Standings, statistics, trends and predictions in one racing-first interface.

Development & rules

Shape the season with configurable rules and team development systems.

Still

A study companion that stays quiet. Start a session, understand where your time went, build a journal and use calming offline sounds without turning focus into another noisy productivity system.
Start, then disappear

Pick a subject and topic, begin studying, and let the interface get out of the way.

Honest reports

See time invested, sessions, averages and subjects without pointless gamification.

Offline atmosphere

Built-in focus sounds with no streaming requirement and no account needed.

LEFT

A private budgeting app designed around the question normal budget apps bury: what do I actually have left? See your pace, safe spend, savings trajectory and whether a purchase fits right now.
Can I afford this?

Turn a ₹4,999 decision into a simple answer based on the month you are actually having.

Useful insights

Categories, weekly rhythm, averages and spending patterns without drowning in charts.

Private by design

Local-first data, backup and CSV tools without requiring a cloud account.

THE ATOMIC.DEV PRINCIPLE
“I don't invent new concepts for the sake of it. I build the tool I wished existed; Still, a study planner without the bloat, GridHQ, a race director for the season I wanted to run, and LEFT, a budget app that tells you what you actually have left.”
